ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line AD intersects with BE at point O, angles $\angle DOE$ and $\angle COE$ are complementary. If $\angle COE=72^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $\angle DOE$ and $\angle COE$ are complementary,\\
therefore $\angle DOE + \angle COE = 90^\circ$,\\
since $\angle COE = 72^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle DOE = 18^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOB = \angle DOE = \boxed{18^\circ}$
